set.description: 区分随机事件、必然事件和不可能事件。
set.name: Random Events, Certain Events, and Impossible Events
set.nameZh: 随机事件、必然事件与不可能事件

criteria: 能说出分母表示平均分成了几份
能在具体量里说出一个分数表示多少
set.description: 理解分数表示把整体平均分后的几份，分母是平均分的份数，分子是取出的份数。
set.name: Meaning of Fractions

criteria: 能根据个位判断是不是 2 的倍数
能根据个位判断是不是 5 的倍数
set.description: 知道个位是 0、2、4、6、8 的数是 2 的倍数，个位是 0 或 5 的数是 5 的倍数。
set.name: Characteristics of multiples of 2 and 5

criteria: 能用乘法公式计算两个事件同时发生的概率
能按先后顺序写出条件概率
set.description: When P(A)>0, P(A intersection B)=P(A)*P(B|A). Multiply in event order using the appropriate conditional probabilities. If P(A)=0, the intersection probability is zero directly; the elementary P(B|A) ratio is undefined.
set.name: Multiplication Rule for Probability

set.reason: Probability endpoints and uncertainty require the event categories.
set.scope: probability of random, certain, impossible events

set.reason: Favorable outcomes give a fraction of a finite equal-likelihood whole.
set.scope: probability as favorable over total

set.reason: An explicit target criterion distinguishes mutually exclusive from complementary events. The prerequisite node explicitly assesses recognizing mutual exclusivity. Deriving the complementary probability formula by addition is an optional further use, not this universal scope.
set.scope: Recognizing mutually exclusive events when contrasting exclusivity with complementarity

set.reason: The explicit independence/exclusivity contrast requires mutual exclusivity.
set.scope: distinguishing independence from mutual exclusivity

set.reason: The total-probability sum contains branch terms P(B_i) times P(A given B_i); computing these branch products uses the conditional multiplication identity.
set.scope: computing each branch term P(Bi)P(A|Bi)

set.reason: The explicit even-number units-digit criterion is the multiple-of-two units-digit test. The multiple-of-five part of the endpoint is outside this required scope.
set.scope: stating the units-digit feature of even numbers

criteria: 能说出概率的取值范围
能计算简单的等可能事件概率
set.description: 概率是衡量随机事件发生可能性大小的数，等可能事件的概率等于所求结果数除以总结果数。
set.name: The Meaning of Probability and the Probability of Equally Likely Events
set.nameZh: 概率的意义与等可能事件的概率

criteria: 能判断一个数是奇数还是偶数
能说出偶数的个位特征
set.description: 知道偶数是 2 的倍数，不能被 2 整除的是奇数。
set.name: Odd and even numbers

criteria: 能用乘法计算两个独立事件同时发生的概率
能说出独立和互斥不同
set.description: 知道若 P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B)，则 A 与 B 相互独立。独立不是互斥。
set.name: Independence of Events

criteria: 能把样本分成互斥的几类
能计算全概率
set.description: 若几种原因互斥且覆盖全部可能，事件的概率等于各原因的概率乘以相应条件概率后再相加。
set.name: Law of Total Probability

criteria: 能判断两个事件是否互斥
能计算互斥事件的并的概率
set.description: 会用互斥事件的加法：P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)。也会用容斥处理不互斥的情形。
set.name: Addition of Probabilities

criteria: 能判断一对事件是互斥还是对立
能计算对立事件的概率
set.description: 能区分互斥和对立：对立一定互斥，互斥不一定对立。
set.name: Mutually Exclusive and Complementary Events
